comments.text: Pulled new GDrive corpus with prefix narrowed to Single Day-2026-03-09.csv; 1001 transcripts extracted into individual text items with UUID sidecars; reindexed catalog (1002 items). Built pass-through extraction snapshot pipeline:27887cbe4f7070b0b3cbdc2e7574a72b49700fbbc2f3f860a62e40d97043ddf8. comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Full Residio GDrive corpus reindexed (1001 transcripts, no truncation). New extraction snapshot pipeline:de8e3cd8e054814ac4354644aa55ba21fd17b13a0c336dbc6a8c2fda7e36efc9. comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting the topic-driven Residio HMM implementation. Scope: add new Alfa-style agent-phase Markov config (topic_label observations + state naming), upgrade markov_run_report.py to surface named states/artifacts/config-driven narrative, add a separate topic_modeling_run_report.py for customer-intent topic runs, add lightweight report tests, then rerun topic-modeling smoke/full and the new full HMM recipe.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Topic-modeling smoke run succeeded with the existing Residio customer-intent recipe against the full non-truncated extraction snapshot. Command used biblicus analyze topics with configurations/analysis/residio-topic.yml, extraction snapshot pipeline:de8e3cd8e054814ac4354644aa55ba21fd17b13a0c336dbc6a8c2fda7e36efc9, sample_size=50, and conservative thread env (OMP/BLAS/NUMBA=1). Snapshot 1d864777ec83106ad299cdb8718a87af4569a5352021a20c8f533099dc3b3486 completed successfully with 50 documents and 2 topics, so I am proceeding to the full topic run.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Reprioritized to the full HMM run after the user clarified the immediate target was the Residio HMM fix, not the separate customer-intent topic rerun. Stopped the in-flight full topic run and launched the new topic-driven HMM config configurations/analysis/residio-markov-agent-phases-topic-driven.yml against extraction snapshot pipeline:de8e3cd8e054814ac4354644aa55ba21fd17b13a0c336dbc6a8c2fda7e36efc9. Full HMM snapshot 9027e126a8c886966369cd62d988bb2d2bbf1606981f82d74a2ec7edc9b9a575 completed: 12 states, 132 transitions, 5927 segments, embedded segment topic_modeling complete with 93 topics. Acceptance check: exactly one START, exactly one END, and unknown_count=0. Generated report.md, report.pdf, transitions.png, topic_modeling.json, topic_assignments.jsonl, segments.jsonl, and observations.jsonl in the run directory.
